description_en: Queries the details of a quota for a specified Alibaba Cloud product
description_zh: 查询目标云产品的配额详情
kebab_example: aliyun quotas get-product-quota --product-code ecs --quota-action-code q_security-groups --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetProductQuota

parameters.help_en:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud product name.

For more information, see the ProductCode parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html中的0
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_zh:

fields.help_en:
The key of the quota dimension.

Dimensions.N.Key and Dimensions.N.Value must be specified at the same time. The value of N is determined by the number of dimensions that the Alibaba Cloud product supports. You can call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation to query the supported dimensions. The value of N is the length of the returned array
fields.help_zh:
配额维度的Key。

`Dimensions.N.Key`和`Dimensions.N.Value`必须同时设置。N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数。您可以通过[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回数组长度就是N
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:

Dimensions.N.Key and Dimensions.N.Value must be specified at the same time. The value of N is determined by the number of dimensions that the Alibaba Cloud product supports. You can call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation to query the supported dimensions. The value of N is the length of the returned array
fields.help_zh:
配额维度的Value。

`Dimensions.N.Key`和`Dimensions.N.Value`必须同时设置。N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数。您可以通过[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回数组长度就是N
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The quota dimensions.
A quota dimension is a property of a quota. The combination of Dimensions and QuotaActionCode uniquely identifies a quota.

Dimensions are required for some Alibaba Cloud products. You can call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation to query the dimensions of a quota and check whether the dimensions are required. The Requisite parameter in the response indicates whether a dimension is required
parameters.help_zh:
配额维度。
配额项的属性，维度（Dimensions）+配额ID（QuotaActionCode）确定唯一的配额项。
部分云产品维度必填。云产品的配额是什么，以及配额是否必填可以从[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)获取，返回参数`Requisite`表示该维度是否必填

Adjustable.description_en:
Indicates whether the quota is adjustable. Valid values:

true: The quota is adjustable.

false: The quota is not adjustable
Adjustable.description_zh:
配额是否可调整。取值：

true：可调整。

false：不可调整

ApplicableRange.description_en: The adjustable range of the quota

items.description_en: The adjustable range of the quota. For example: `[802,10000]`

ApplicableType.description_en:
The type of the adjustable quota. Valid values:

continuous: The quota value is continuous.

discontinuous: The quota value is discontinuous
ApplicableType.description_zh:
配额调整类型。取值：

continuous：连续。

discontinuous：间断

ApplyReasonTips.example: The business xxx is expected to grow by 50%.

QuotaDescription.example: The maximum number of security groups that can be owned by the current account.

QuotaUnit.description_en:
The unit of the quota.

The units of quotas vary. For example, the unit of the `q_cbdch3` quota, which is the maximum number of clusters, for Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) is Cluster. The unit of the `q_security-groups` quota, which is the maximum number of security groups, for Elastic Compute Service (ECS) is Count
QuotaUnit.description_zh:
配额单位。

每个配额的单位不同。例如：容器服务Kubernetes版的配额`q_cbdch3`（最大集群数）单位为Cluster，云服务器ECS的配额`q_security-groups`（安全组总数量上限）单位为个

Type.description_en:
The quota type. Valid values:

BaseQuota

ReservedQuota
Type.description_zh:
配额类别。取值：

ReservedQuota：预留配额

QuotaType.description_en:
The type of the quota. Valid values:

privilege

normal
QuotaType.description_zh:
配额类型。取值：

privilege：特权。

normal：普通

QuotaUnit.description_en:
The unit of the quota.

The units of quotas vary. For example, the unit of the `q_cbdch3` quota, which is the maximum number of clusters, for Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) is Cluster. The unit of the `q_security-groups` quota, which is the maximum number of security groups, for Elastic Compute Service (ECS) is Count
QuotaUnit.description_zh:
配额单位。

每个配额的单位不同。例如：容器服务Kubernetes版的配额`q_cbdch3`（最大集群数）单位为Cluster，云服务器ECS的配额`q_security-groups`（安全组总数量上限）单位为个

SupportedRange.description_en: The range of the quota value that is supported by the quota. You can refer to this range when you configure a quota template
SupportedRange.description_zh: 当前配额项支持的配额值区间，用于配置配额模板时进行参考

items.description_en:
The range of the quota value that is supported by the quota. You can refer to this range when you configure a quota template.

If ApplicableType is set to continuous and the value of this parameter is [802,1000], the quota value can be any integer from 802 to 1000.

If ApplicableType is set to discontinuous and the value of this parameter is [10,20,50,100], the quota value can be 10, 20, 50, or 100
items.description_zh:
当前配额项支持的配额值区间，用于配置配额模板时进行参考。

当ApplicableType为continuous时，如果取值为[802,1000]，则表示取值为802~1000中的所有整数。

当ApplicableType为discontinuous时，如果取值为[10,20,50,100]，则表示取值仅为10、20、50和100

UnadjustableDetail.description_en:
The reason why the quota is not adjustable. Valid values:

nonactivated: The service is not activated.

applicationProcess: The quota increase request is being processed.

limitReached: The quota limit is reached.

supportTicketRequired: You must submit a ticket to request a quota increase
UnadjustableDetail.description_zh:
配额不可调整原因。取值：

nonactivated：未开通服务。

applicationProcess：配额申请处理中。

limitReached：已达配额上限。

supportTicketRequired：需要提工单申请
